name: serveros-fleet-next
description: Fleet Next — cloud-side Skills that route a ChatGPT request to an authorized ServerOS device, runtime and Session and report what was actually accepted. Instruction-only: this package declares no MCP server, carries no credentials and grants no device access.

com.serveros.fleet-next.note: The 1.0.0 manifest schema defines no icon property and forbids additional ones, so the icon is declared here and shipped as a file. Whether any client reads this key is UNVERIFIED.
